automated red teaming holds substantial promise for uncovering and mitigating the risks associated with the malicious use of large language models (llms), yet the field lacks a standardized evaluation framework to rigorously assess these methods
we introduce HarmBench, a standardized evaluation framework for automated red teaming
Using HarmBench, we conduct a large-scale comparison of red teaming methods and target LLMs and defenses, yielding novel insights.
There are two primary ways to use HarmBench: (1) evaluating red teaming methods against a set of LLMs, and (2) evaluating LLMs against a set of red teaming methods.
we also introduce a highly efficient adversarial training method that greatly enhances llm robustness across a wide range of attacks
